description: First Solar, Inc. is the leading PV solar technology and manufacturing company in the Americas and the only U.S.-headquartered company among the world's largest solar manufacturers, focused on competitively and reliably enabling power generation needs with its advanced, uniquely American thin film PV technology. Developed at R&D labs in California and Ohio, its technology provides a competitive, high-performance and responsibly produced alternative to conventional crystalline silicon PV solar modules, and its PV solar modules are produced using a fully integrated, continuous process that does not rely on Chinese crystalline silicon supply chains. It is the world's largest thin film PV solar module manufacturer and the largest PV solar module manufacturer in the Western Hemisphere.
